name: Google Pub/Sub
description: Typed Pub/Sub topics, pull subscriptions, bounded publish/pull, explicit acknowledgements, snapshots and schema revisions.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS Pub/Sub REST v1 calls at pubsub.googleapis.com using an encrypted OAuth bearer token; confirmed effects include publish, pull visibility, ack/deadline changes, seek, resource and schema changes. Alternative tokenSecret needs host authorization. No filesystem/ambient credentials, automatic retries, refresh, listeners or build-time provider access.

definitions.name: Publish Pub/Sub Batch
definitions.documentation: Publish Pub/Sub Batch: POST /{topic}:publish. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PUBLISH_BATCH. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.documentation: List Pub/Sub Subscriptions: GET /{project}/subscriptions. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Create Pub/Sub Pull Subscription
definitions.documentation: Create Pub/Sub Pull Subscription: PUT /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CREATE_SUBSCRIPTION. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Patch Pub/Sub Subscription
definitions.documentation: Patch Pub/Sub Subscription: PATCH /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PATCH_SUBSCRIPTION. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Acknowledge Pub/Sub Messages
definitions.documentation: Acknowledge Pub/Sub Messages: POST /{subscription}:acknowledge. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ACKNOWLEDGE_MESSAGES. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.documentation: Patch Pub/Sub Snapshot Labels: PATCH /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PATCH_SNAPSHOT. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Validate Pub/Sub Message
definitions.documentation: Validate Pub/Sub Message: POST /{parent}/schemas:validateMessage. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation.
